summary.en: NEXT AI is Canada's flagship AI-focused accelerator and founder development program, run by NEXT Canada in Toronto and Montreal. It runs 20+ sector-specific streams (AI, Quantum, Space, Climate, Health, Defence, Oceans, Web3 and more), takes no equity and charges no fees, and reports CAD $51B in equity value creation across 4,000+ ventures.

summary.en: Centech is a Montreal deeptech and medtech incubator/accelerator founded in 1996 by ÉTS. Its free 12-week Acceleration Program for science/engineering startups feeds the National Bank-backed two-year Propulsion Program (entry grant up to $15,000). UBI Global ranked it among the world's top 10 university incubators in 2023.
